title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Matters Subject to Appraisal) Performance appraisals shall cover the ability of persons subject to appraisal to perform their duties, their attitude toward performing such duties, and other personnel-management matters determined by the President of the Constitutional Court.
